intro: Madagascar grows most of the world's vanilla.

chapters.title: How it earns
text: Vanilla, cloves, nickel, cobalt and textiles are major exports. Most people farm rice. Deforestation threatens wildlife.

chapters.title: Tourism
text: Wildlife tourism brings visitors to see lemurs.

cardGroups.intro: Some of the things Madagascar makes and sells to the world.
